claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_spell_grant family for ClassFeatureMechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The unit grants always-prepared spells at specific class levels with no activation cost, no use-count resource, and no reset cadence. The only existing ClassFeatureMechanics family is 'activation', which requires all three. A passive, level-gated spell-access family is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you reach a Sorcerer level specified in the Draconic Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access variant for ClassFeatureEffect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: ClassFeatureEffect is currently GrantExtraActionEffect | HealHpEffect. Neither represents spell access. The v4 atom grant_spell_access exists but is unreachable from any ClassFeatureMechanics path.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Draconic Spells table: Level 3 — Alter Self, Chromatic Orb, Command, Dragon's Breath; Level 5 — Fear, Fly; Level 7 — Arcane Eye, Charm Monster; Level 9 — Legend Lore, Summon Dragon.

discrepancies: no content/sorcerer_draconic_spells_l3.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
